en: We have to bring people step-by-step into understanding, what does it mean to have AI doing things for you?
zh: 我们必须一步一步地带人们去理解：让 AI 替你做事意味着什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What does trust mean here?
zh: 在这里，信任意味着什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: You're asking it to like, have my credit card, take care of things, understand my life?
zh: 你是在要求它，比如，拿着我的信用卡、替我打理事情、理解我的生活？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we build trust and privacy in?
zh: 我们如何把信任和隐私构建进去？

speaker: Unknown
en: And you talk about how Apple kind of ships a new version of the software and the hardware yearly.
zh: 你谈到 Apple 差不多是每年发布一个新版本的软件和硬件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's incredible motion to bring people along on this journey.
zh: 而这种带动人们踏上这段旅程的动作是非常了不起的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And sometimes I always wonder how much faster are people really ready to keep changing their lives up and they bet on one thing and then they're wrong two months later and they have to change everything.
zh: 有时我一直好奇，人们到底有多快真的准备好不断改变自己的生活——他们押注了一样东西，两个月后发现错了，然后不得不把一切推翻重来。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of regular consumers who are just trying to get through their lives, their jobs, maybe things that aren't as immediately impacted by AI.
zh: 很多只想过好自己的生活、干好自己的工作、可能所处领域没有立刻被 AI 冲击的普通消费者，

speaker: Unknown
en: Aren't necessarily at that same pace.
zh: 未必能跟上那样的节奏。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm looking for those companies and those founders that can bring people really on that journey.
zh: 所以我在寻找那些能真正带领人们踏上这段旅程的公司和创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love you mentioned trust, Sage.
zh: 我很高兴你提到了信任，Sage。

speaker: Unknown
en: You think trust is a new big mode for consumer AI apps and companies?
zh: 你认为信任会成为消费级 AI 应用和公司的一个新的重要护城河吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, I think in these early days of adoption, utility often trumps trust.
zh: 我是说，我认为在采用的早期阶段，实用性往往胜过信任。

speaker: Unknown
en: People will try new things and they'll experiment with it.
zh: 人们会尝试新事物，会去实验。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you truly want to break into the mainstream and really get to the hundreds of millions or billions, trust ends up becoming paramount and the seriousness of a company and how it doesn't want your data to make itself better and trade that with other people, but wants your data.
zh: 但如果你真的想打入主流，真正触达数亿或数十亿用户，信任最终会变得至关重要，还有一家公司的认真态度——它不想用你的数据来让自己变得更好并与其他人做交易，而是想要你的数据

speaker: Unknown
en: Only in order to help give you a better experience becomes important dividing lines.
zh: 只是为了帮助你获得更好的体验——这些会成为重要的分界线。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the things that will break into the mainstream will have a fundamental tenet of trust.
zh: 我认为那些能打入主流的东西，会把信任作为一条根本原则。

speaker: Unknown
en: And just the way we search for items or things for online now for research, like I didn't know when the last time you Googled something, but I haven't Googled something in ages.
zh: 而且就拿我们现在在网上搜索条目或东西做调研的方式来说——我不知道你上次用 Google 搜索是什么时候，但我已经很久很久没用 Google 搜过东西了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go to Claude or I go to GPT, Gemini sometimes with different things.
zh: 我会用 Claude，或者用 GPT、Gemini，视不同的事情而定。

speaker: Unknown
en: The fundamental way we search for online now has radically changed forever.
zh: 我们现在在网上搜索的根本方式已经永远地发生了彻底的改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a great point.
zh: 这是个很好的观点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think Google for a search when I kind of know what I want but I don't quite know and I want to describe it, it's hard to get exactly what I want out of that and I personally find myself going to ChatGPT or Gemini as a starting point for a lot of these conversations.
zh: 我用 Google 搜索的情况是，当我大概知道自己想要什么但又不太确定、我想描述一下的时候，很难从那里得到我确切想要的东西，我个人发现自己在很多这样的场景里会先去找 ChatGPT 或 Gemini 开启对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was recently looking for a keychain that makes it really easy to split for when I have to park at a valet garage and then put it back together and
zh: 我最近在找一个钥匙扣，它能让我在必须把车停在代客泊车车库时非常方便地拆开，然后再装回去，

speaker: Unknown
en: I was having so much trouble on Google trying to find something, on Amazon trying to find something.
zh: 我在 Google 上费了好大劲想找一样东西，在 Amazon 上也想找。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I went to ChatGPT and started having this great conversation.
zh: 然后我去找 ChatGPT，开始了一段非常棒的对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it found me a bunch of, it kind of described to me a bunch of the different attachments and the way that they could connect and easily break a bunch of the ways that those either had maintenance problems or the ones that were most likely to be durable over the years.
zh: 它给我找到了很多，它向我描述了各种不同的连接件以及它们连接和轻松拆开的方式，还有其中哪些存在维护问题、哪些最有可能经久耐用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I said, and I really want one that's made in America and helped me find just the right one that was made by a store in Michigan.
zh: 然后我说，我真的想要一个美国制造的，它帮我找到了正合适的一个，是密歇根州一家店铺做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it was kind of this incredible journey that it was a conversation about shopping, not Googling, clicking on links and having to do all the work myself.
zh: 所以这有点像一段不可思议的旅程——那是一场关于购物的对话，而不是去 Google 搜索、点开链接、然后所有活都得自己干。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think, you know, that experience is just one of so many, but there's still so many ways that I could have productized that to be a lot better experience.
zh: 而且我认为，这样的体验只是众多体验之一，但仍然有很多方式可以把它产品化，变成好得多的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And still, I kind of still wanted a chance to browse at the end of my journey.
zh: 而且，在我整个寻找过程的最后，我其实还是想要一个可以浏览的机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And ChatGPT had kind of helped me narrow on like one option.
zh: ChatGPT 已经帮我把范围缩小到差不多一个选项。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I really still wanted now that shopping browse experience, but with all of my conditions laid out.
zh: 而我真正想要的，是在我已经摆好所有条件的前提下，再获得那种购物浏览的体验，

speaker: Unknown
en: So then I could really kind of explore from like the perfect set of options.
zh: 这样我就能真正从一个近乎完美的选项集合中去探索。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we think about those new experiences for shopping online, you know, especially through these AI models, what would you like to see that still hasn't emerged yet?
zh: 当我们思考线上购物这些新体验的时候，尤其是通过这些 AI 模型实现的，你还希望看到什么目前尚未出现的形态？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, you spent 10 years at Apple, so you probably got a whole bunch of ideas, right, on how you can make this product so much better.
zh: 你知道，你在 Apple 待了 10 年，所以关于如何把这个产品做得好得多，你肯定有一大堆想法，对吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because right now it is still pretty basic.
zh: 因为现在它仍然相当初级。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's only six and a half, not quite six years at Apple, but it was an incredible time there.
zh: 其实还不到 6 年半，我在 Apple 待了不到 6 年，但那是一段不可思议的时光。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when I think about shopping, what's really interesting is the best experience is when you can have a concierge experience at a store and you have somebody who's a true expert.
zh: 但当我想到购物时，真正有趣的是，最好的体验是当你在店里能有礼宾服务，有一个真正专家的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're guiding you, commenting on maybe what looks great, helping you try different things on.
zh: 他们在引导你，评论什么看起来很棒，帮助你试穿不同的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even better is when you know that their only incentive is your success.
zh: 而更好的是，当你知道他们唯一的动机就是你的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: Their incentive is not to get you to spend the most money or buy something where they get a kickback, but it's truly that guidance in helping you.
zh: 他们的动机不是让你花最多的钱，或者买他们能拿回扣的东西，而是真正地在引导和帮助你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm really excited to find the companies that can sort of bring us that experience, but using AI to actually simplify from the vast array of options.
zh: 所以我非常期待找到那些能带给我们这种体验的公司，用 AI 从海量的选择中真正实现简化。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's truly on our side and it's something that we learn to trust because it has our best interests and all of our questions.
zh: 但它真正站在我们这一边，是我们学会去信任的东西，因为它以我们最大的利益为出发点，解答我们所有的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm very happy to, you know...
zh: 而且我也很乐意，你知道……

speaker: Unknown
en: Try something on, take a picture, take a picture of stuff I have that I want to upgrade and have AI comment on that and make it better.
zh: 试穿某件衣服，拍张照，把我现有的想升级的东西拍张照，让 AI 对此发表评论并让它变得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: This thing I'm wearing actually designed completely with AI, where I said I wanted a new black polo sweater and it actually helped me figure out the design and went in, actually had it manufactured for me in China.

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm so excited by sort of all of these ways that we can improve the experience, but it truly has to be something that's on my side.
zh: 所以我对所有这些能改善体验的方式感到非常兴奋，但它真的必须是站在我这一边的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: There you go, Josh.
zh: 给你了，Josh。

en: If VC doesn't work out for you, I'm sure it will, but you could always become a fashion designer.

speaker: Unknown
en: Looks pretty good.
zh: 看起来相当不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: I treat it all to the tool.
zh: 我把这一切都归功于那个工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just described what I wanted and it did an amazing job for me.
zh: 我只是描述了我想要什么，它就为我做了一件非常出色的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think it goes to show, you know, this is how far we have come in four and a half years.
zh: 但我想这说明了，你看，这就是四年半以来我们走了多远。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next even 12 months, I think it's going to be incredibly exciting.
zh: 接下来的哪怕 12 个月，我认为都会令人难以置信地兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are some of the trends you're really excited about coming from a consumer lens that you're really excited to see in startups and hopefully back them?
zh: 从消费者的视角来看，有哪些趋势是你真正感到兴奋、希望在初创公司中看到并有望投资的？

speaker: Unknown
en: There's so many ways that AI is going to reinvent the experiences that we do every day.
zh: AI 将以非常多的方式重新发明我们每天都在做的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, it almost goes from anything.
zh: 我是说，几乎涵盖一切。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你知道，我首先要说的是让我非常兴奋的个人智能体，它是站在我这边的东西，当我试图弄清楚这个周末要做什么时，我可以依靠它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe scheduling appointments or helping me monitor my health, whether it's helping me think about my finances and whether there's opportunities I'm missing out, whether it's just simply checking in and making sure I've had a good day and see if there's anything I need to just do that's on my mind.
zh: 也许是安排预约，或者帮助我监测我的健康，无论是帮助我思考我的财务状况、是否有我错过的机会，还是仅仅简单地问候一声，确认我今天过得好不好，看看有没有我心里惦记着需要做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That moment of something even just checking in with you.
zh: 那种时刻，哪怕只是问候你一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can either be naggy if done poorly, but amazing when done right.
zh: 做得不好会显得很烦人，但做得对就非常棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it feels like it's really on your side and it's helping you think through things.
zh: 而且它让你感觉真的站在你这一边，帮助你把事情想清楚。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this area of personal agents, and I went through a few of the verticals too, things like health and finances and setting your goals and helping you kind of get through your day better.
zh: 所以个人智能体这个领域，我也过了一遍一些垂直领域，比如健康、财务、设定你的目标，帮助你更好地度过你的一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe it's helping you shop and make sure you have the right amount of food at home that you need.
zh: 也许是帮助你购物，确保家里有你所需的适量食物。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe it's helping you plan something fun because it can notice, hey,
zh: 也许是帮助你规划一些有趣的事，因为它能注意到，嘿，

speaker: Unknown
en: This weekend you have a lighter weekend and maybe it's time to go out and there's amazing weather and or this incredible festival is happening.
zh: 这个周末你比较清闲，也许是时候出门了，天气非常好，或者有一个很棒的节庆活动正在举行。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's one area of just these personal agents that become part of our lives that are very, very different than all the work agents that are helping us work more productively.
zh: 这是其中一个领域，就是这些成为我们生活一部分的个人智能体，它们与所有帮助我们更高效工作的办公智能体非常、非常不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second area I get really excited about is the future of entertainment.
zh: 我真正感到兴奋的第二个领域是娱乐的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now...
zh: 现在……

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, there's so many things to watch and things to experience, but you end up having to just consume and absorb.
zh: 你知道，有那么多东西可以看、可以体验，但你最终只能被动地消费和吸收。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what's really fun is when media is interactive and exciting and it's your world.
zh: 而真正有趣的是当媒体是互动的、令人兴奋的、属于你的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, when you're watching a story, one of my favorite shows is on Apple TV.
zh: 你知道，当你在看一个故事时——我最喜欢的节目之一在 Apple TV 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's called For All Mankind.
zh: 它叫 For All Mankind。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's so many times that I'm like, I would love to go deeper on the backstory here, or I would love to imagine if this happened instead.
zh: 有很多次我都在想，我真想深入了解这里的背景故事，或者我想想象如果发生的是另一件事会怎样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now with AI, you could imagine that any world that you're in, you can go much deeper, you can have these experiences.
zh: 现在有了 AI，你可以想象，无论你身处哪个世界，你都可以深入得多，你可以拥有这些体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even so, I want to then be able to share them with somebody.
zh: 甚至更进一步，我还想能够把它们分享给别人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's sort of in the fan fiction world, but you can do this even for new worlds and worlds that somebody else creates and lets me start to experience and explore and add into.
zh: 这有点像同人小说的世界，但即使对于全新的世界、由别人创造并让我开始体验、探索和参与添加的世界，你也可以这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think of what Roblox has become as just an incredible phenomenon of all of these games, all these shared experiences people have.
zh: 我想到 Roblox 已经成为的样子，它就是一个了不起的现象，汇集了所有这些游戏、所有人们拥有的共享体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that there's, you know, it's still very much kind of in the game world and has a certain group that really enjoy Roblox.
zh: 而且我认为，它目前仍在很大程度上属于游戏世界，并且有一群真正喜爱 Roblox 的特定人群。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that opportunity is even bigger for so many more types of generated experiences.
zh: 而我认为，对于更多类型的生成式体验来说，这个机会甚至更大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're going to have a world of creators that can imagine these worlds that we then get to participate in and interact in.
zh: 我们将会拥有一个创作者的世界，他们可以想象出这些世界，然后我们去参与和互动。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think in terms of, you know, verticals, I mentioned travel, or I mentioned health and finance, but I also believe in travel.
zh: 我想，在垂直领域方面，我提到过旅行，或者提到过健康和金融，但我也相信旅行这个领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, right now, when you want to go somewhere, you are spending some of your hardest earned time and money to have a great experience.
zh: 你知道，现在，当你想去某个地方时，你是在花费你最辛苦赚来的时间和金钱去获得一次美好的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yet, you don't always have full visibility in what's there and you can't always express your own personal interests.
zh: 然而你对那里有什么并不总是有充分的了解，你也并不总是能表达自己的个人兴趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Having an expert that can actually help bridge that gap is an incredible opportunity.
zh: 拥有一位能真正帮助弥合这一鸿沟的专家，是一个了不起的机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the same thing is true for shopping, for fashion, for setting up your home, for upgrading your home life in ways that you don't think about.
zh: 我认为购物、时尚、布置你的家、以你意想不到的方式升级你的家居生活也是如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this whole world of kind of vertical services that are much more powered by AI and very different interaction model and very, very personalized to you.
zh: 所以这整个世界，就是由 AI 更强力驱动、拥有截然不同交互模式、并且对你高度个性化服务的垂直领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those are just some of the things I get really excited about.
zh: 这些只是我真正感到兴奋的一些事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, there's so many more, you know, we talked about fashion and being able to actually have something made for you that you've designed in your mind, being able to connect with people in ways that AI facilitates.
zh: 我是说，还有很多更多，你知道的，我们谈到了时尚，能够真正把你脑海中设计的东西做出来，能够以 AI 促进的方式与人连接。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's like, hey, I want to ask this question, but you can role play it with AI and then it might actually do some of the work to go reach out on your behalf to some things and bring you back answers before you actually then go have the human connection.
zh: 就像是，嘿，我想问这个问题，但你可以先用 AI 角色扮演一下，然后它可能真的会替你去做一些工作去联系某些方面，在你真正去进行人与人之间的连接之前，把答案带回来给你。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to add a replace human connection, but anything it can do to get me closer to having even better, more impactful human moments is going to be incredible.
zh: 我不想增加或取代人与人之间的连接，但任何能让我更接近拥有更好、更有影响力的人际时刻的事情，都会是不可思议的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I love all of these trends.

en: I'll be very honest, like when I saw these live shopping companies, you know, in Europe and in the US, I was like...

speaker: Unknown

en: What have they done so well that maybe consumers just didn't quite see?
zh: 他们做对了什么，以至于可能消费者只是没有完全看到？

en: And investors as well.

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, I think live shopping is just an incredible category.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think Whatnot as a company has done a fabulous job really expanding their marketplace and expanding all the ways in which people can buy things.
zh: 而且 我认为 Whatnot 作为一家公司在真正扩展他们的市场以及扩展人们购物的各种方式方面做得非常出色。

en: And I've gotten to help do that.

speaker: Unknown
en: I was never a founder myself.
zh: 我自己从来不是创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never went and started a company from scratch, but I was always what I call an early joiner, where I'd go find these things and say, we're gonna go make something great.
zh: 我从未从零开始创办一家公司，但我一直是我所说的早期加入者，我会去找到这些项目并说，我们要去做出伟大的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have an incredible idea that's getting started, has some momentum.
zh: 你有一个不可思议的想法正在起步，有一些势头。

speaker: Unknown
en: How can we make it last?
zh: 我们如何让它持久？

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's so much joy in that.
zh: 这其中有无穷的乐趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the stuff we did at Twitter is probably some of the most meaningful work of my life and still see it to this day play out.
zh: 我们在 Twitter 做的事情大概是我一生中最有意义的工作之一，直到今天仍能看到它持续发挥影响。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I still feel like, ah, it could have even been so much bigger and so much more important than what it is, even though it's a product I still use the most every day.
zh: 而且我仍然觉得，啊，它本可以比现在更大、更重要得多，尽管它仍然是我每天使用最多的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many users were at Twitter when you left?
zh: 你离开 Twitter 时有多少用户？

speaker: Unknown
en: When I left, we had gotten well over 100 million users.
zh: 我离开时，我们的用户已经远超 1 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I joined, we were maybe barely 10 million actives.
zh: 我加入的时候，我们的活跃用户大概勉强只有 1000 万。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the most interesting lesson you learned from Jack Dorsey?
zh: 你从 Jack Dorsey 那里学到的最有趣的教训是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, what's funny is I didn't actually work with Jack.
zh: 你知道，有意思的是，我实际上并没有和 Jack 共事过。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I was at Twitter, it was the Evan Williams era.
zh: 我在 Twitter 的时候，是 Evan Williams 的时代。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Evan had founded Blogger and he had really helped build Blogger and he had this vision for how Twitter was gonna become this next wave of media with people communicating.
zh: Evan 创立了 Blogger,他真正帮助打造了 Blogger,他有这样一个愿景：Twitter 将会成为人们相互交流的下一波媒体浪潮。

speaker: Unknown
en: The single best lesson that I remember from Evan was
zh: 我记得从 Evan 那里学到的最好的一个教训是

speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, we got a lot of smart people in the building.
zh: 嘿，我们楼里有很多聪明人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got a lot of smart people who are using our product every day.
zh: 我们有很多每天在使用我们产品的聪明人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's not just think we know what's best.
zh: 我们不要只想着自己知道什么最好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's listen to them.
zh: 我们要倾听他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's learn.
zh: 我们要学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then when we make decisions, let's make sure we engage with them on our thinking as well.
zh: 然后当我们做决策时，也要确保让他们参与到我们的思考中来。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the most controversial things that Twitter had launched was the retweet.
zh: Twitter 推出过的最具争议的功能之一就是转发(retweet)。

speaker: Unknown
en: The idea that, you know, originally, and this is again, ancient history and sort of the tech world now, but when the retweet first launched, the way people used to do retweet is it would come from their account and it would say RT and then the name of the person you were retweeting.
zh: 这个想法是，你知道，最初——这又是一个科技圈的远古历史了——转发功能刚推出时，人们做转发的方式是：它会来自他们自己的账号，写上 RT,然后是你要转发的那个人的名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: And instead of building that product, everybody realized everyone wants to retweet and share voices from others, but...
zh: 与其打造那样的产品，大家都意识到每个人都想转发、分享别人的声音，但是……

speaker: Unknown
en: decided at Twitter that the authenticity of the original poster was more important than switching the words to look like they came from your name.
zh: Twitter 决定，原发帖者的真实性比把文字换成看起来像是出自你本人之名更重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the retweet became a Josh retweeted Ollie's post and that you would see Ollie's face in your timeline.
zh: 所以转发变成了“Josh 转发了 Ollie 的帖子”，你会在你的时间线上看到 Ollie 的脸。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that was one of those both
zh: 这就是那种既

speaker: Unknown
en: Listen to the world on how they wanted to repeat others' voices and amplify others' voices, but also take a very hard line that it was not about moving the words to the retweeter's voice, but actually maintaining the original tweeter's voice.
zh: 倾听世界关于他们想要如何重复他人声音、放大他人声音的诉求，同时又采取非常强硬的立场：重点不是把文字移到转发者的声音之下，而是要维持原推文者的声音。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, the retweet and the quote tweet feature that we have now are all part of how it still retains the original person's voice.
zh: 你知道，我们现在拥有的转发和引用推文功能，都是它至今仍保留原始发布者声音的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there was this incredible lesson on listening
zh: 这里有一个关于倾听的绝妙教训

speaker: Unknown
en: But still having a strong point of view and then communicating that back out and engaging in discussion even when, you know, a lot of people weren't happy with it at first because it changed the behavior a little bit.
zh: 但仍然要有一个坚定的观点，然后把它传达出去，参与讨论，即使你知道，很多人一开始并不满意，因为它稍微改变了人们的行为。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's insane.
zh: 这太疯狂了。
